name: Duke Nukem 3D
short_description: Duke Nukem 3D on a badge or a desktop
long_description: Duke Nukem 3D, running the DukeNano3D port of Chocolate Duke3D. One package, two engines: an ESP32-S3 badge runs the flash-resident core from the app partition through the instruction cache (no executable RAM), and a desktop runs the native module. Both are built from the same source (c_mpos/duke3d) and share the activity, controls and save files. Includes the compacted shareware episode (E1L1-4), unpacked into RAM at launch; the engine reads it through the host's file callbacks, so nothing is written to storage. On a desktop a full or Atomic GRP can be tested by passing its path as the intent's "grp" extra. The game is GPL v2 or later and the Build engine is under the Build license; sources are at github.com/MicroPythonOS/MicroPythonOS (c_mpos/duke3d) and github.com/DukeNano3D. Touch controls: left half walks and turns, right half is X/Y, A/B and START/MENU; keyboard: arrows, A/B/X/Y, START/MENU. Saves go under the app's prefs directory. The badge engine needs a firmware with mpos_core ABI 9 or newer.
